part.text: Fixed. The bug was in `SearcherBuilder::invert_match` at crates/searcher/src/searcher/mod.rs:359 — it set `self.config.invert_match = false` unconditionally instead of `= yes`, so the flag never propagated to the searcher. All 77 searcher tests pass, including the 5 inversion tests (`invert1`, `passthru_sherlock_invert1`, `line_number_invert1`, `context_sherlock_invert1/2`).
